def CNF : (
  Type
) := (
  B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.CNF
)
def CNFValue : (
  (Nat → Bool) → CNF → Bool
) := (
  B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.evalCNF
)
def ClauseValue : (
  (Nat → Bool) → List (Nat × Bool) → Bool
) := (
  B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.evalClause
)
def CNFVars : (
  CNF → List Nat
) := (
  B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.cnfVars
)
def ReducedClause : (
  (Nat → Option Bool) → List (Nat × Bool) → List (Nat × Bool)
) := (
  fun p c => List.filter (fun l => Option.isNone (p l.1)) c
)
def RestrictedCNF : (
  (Nat → Option Bool) → CNF → CNF
) := (
  fun p f => List.map (ReducedClause p) (List.filter (fun c => !(List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2))) f)
)
def ExtendedAssignment : (
  (Nat → Option Bool) → (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool
) := (
  fun p a n => Option.getD (p n) (a n)
)
def ExtendsPartial : (
  (Nat → Option Bool) → (Nat → Bool) → Prop
) := (
  fun p a => ∀ (n : Nat) (v : Bool), p n = some v → a n = v
)
theorem result : (
  ∀ (p : Nat → Option Bool) (f : CNF), (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ CNFVars (RestrictedCNF p f) → n ∈ CNFVars f ∧ p n = none) ∧ List.length (RestrictedCNF p f) ≤ List.length f ∧ (∀ a : Nat → Bool, CNFValue a (RestrictedCNF p f) = CNFValue (ExtendedAssignment p a) f ∧ ExtendsPartial p (ExtendedAssignment p a)) ∧ ((∃ a : Nat → Bool, CNFValue a (RestrictedCNF p f) = true) ↔ ∃ a : Nat → Bool, ExtendsPartial p a ∧ CNFValue a f = true) ∧ (List.Mem [] (RestrictedCNF p f) → ¬ ∃ a : Nat → Bool, ExtendsPartial p a ∧ CNFValue a f = true) ∧ RestrictedCNF p (RestrictedCNF p f) = RestrictedCNF p f
) := (
  by
    have clauseCore (p : Nat → Option Bool) (a : Nat → Bool) (c : List (Nat × Bool))
        (ha : ExtendsPartial p a) (hn : List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2) = false) :
        ClauseValue a (ReducedClause p c) = ClauseValue a c := by
      apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
      constructor
      · intro hc
        obtain ⟨l, hl, hval⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hc
        obtain ⟨hlc, hfree⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hl
        exact List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨l, hlc, hval⟩
      · intro hc
        obtain ⟨l, hl, hval⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hc
        apply List.any_eq_true.mpr
        refine ⟨l, ?_, hval⟩
        apply List.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨hl, ?_⟩
        cases hp : p l.1 with
        | none => simp [hp]
        | some b =>
          have same : a l.1 = b := ha l.1 b hp
          have hfixed : (p l.1 == some l.2) = true := by
            simpa [B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.evalLiteral, hp, same] using hval
          have hs : List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2) = true :=
            List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨l, hl, hfixed⟩
          simp [hn] at hs
    have compatibleCore (p : Nat → Option Bool) (f : CNF) (a : Nat → Bool)
        (ha : ExtendsPartial p a) : CNFValue a (RestrictedCNF p f) = CNFValue a f := by
      apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
      constructor
      · intro hf
        apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
        intro c hc
        cases hh : List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2) with
        | false =>
          have kept : c ∈ List.filter (fun c => !(List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2))) f :=
            List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hc, by simp [hh]⟩
          have member : List.Mem (ReducedClause p c) (RestrictedCNF p f) := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨c, kept, rfl⟩
          have reduced := List.all_eq_true.mp hf (ReducedClause p c) member
          change ClauseValue a c = true
          rw [← clauseCore p a c ha hh]
          exact reduced
        | true =>
          obtain ⟨l, hl, hfixed⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hh
          have hp : p l.1 = some l.2 := by simpa using hfixed
          have same := ha l.1 l.2 hp
          apply List.any_eq_true.mpr
          refine ⟨l, hl, ?_⟩
          simp [B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.evalLiteral, same]
      · intro hf
        apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
        intro c hc
        obtain ⟨original, kept, equation⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
        subst c
        obtain ⟨member, notHit⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp kept
        have hh : List.any original (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2) = false := by simpa using notHit
        change ClauseValue a (ReducedClause p original) = true
        rw [clauseCore p a original ha hh]
        exact List.all_eq_true.mp hf original member
    have extensionLaw (p : Nat → Option Bool) (a : Nat → Bool) :
        ExtendsPartial p (ExtendedAssignment p a) := by
      intro n v hn
      simp [ExtendedAssignment, hn]
    intro p f
    have support : ∀ n : Nat, n ∈ CNFVars (RestrictedCNF p f) → n ∈ CNFVars f ∧ p n = none := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hv⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hn
      obtain ⟨original, kept, equation⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
      subst c
      obtain ⟨member, notHit⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp kept
      obtain ⟨l, hl, eqn⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
      subst n
      obtain ⟨hlc, hfree⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hl
      refine ⟨List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨original, member, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hlc, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      exact Option.isNone_iff_eq_none.mp hfree
    have value (a : Nat → Bool) : CNFValue a (RestrictedCNF p f) = CNFValue (ExtendedAssignment p a) f := by
      have same : ∀ n : Nat, n ∈ CNFVars (RestrictedCNF p f) → a n = ExtendedAssignment p a n := by
        intro n hn
        have info := support n hn
        simp [ExtendedAssignment, info.2]
      have localEqual := B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.result (RestrictedCNF p f) a (ExtendedAssignment p a) same
      exact Eq.trans localEqual (compatibleCore p f (ExtendedAssignment p a) (extensionLaw p a))
    refine ⟨support, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        List.length (RestrictedCNF p f) = List.length (List.filter (fun c => !(List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2))) f) := List.length_map ..
        _ ≤ List.length f := List.length_filter_le (fun c => !(List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2))) f
    · intro a
      exact ⟨value a, extensionLaw p a⟩
    · constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
        refine ⟨ExtendedAssignment p a, extensionLaw p a, ?_⟩
        rw [← value a]
        exact ha
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨a, hp, ha⟩ := h
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        rw [compatibleCore p f a hp]
        exact ha
    · intro empty models
      obtain ⟨a, hp, ha⟩ := models
      have remaining : CNFValue a (RestrictedCNF p f) = true := by
        rw [compatibleCore p f a hp]
        exact ha
      have impossible := List.all_eq_true.mp remaining [] empty
      simp [B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.evalClause] at impossible
    · have unchanged (c : List (Nat × Bool)) (hc : List.Mem c (RestrictedCNF p f)) : ReducedClause p c = c := by
        apply List.filter_eq_self.mpr
        intro l hl
        have member : l.1 ∈ CNFVars (RestrictedCNF p f) :=
          List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨c, hc, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩⟩
        have info := support l.1 member
        simp [info.2]
      have keepAll : List.filter (fun c => !(List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2))) (RestrictedCNF p f) = RestrictedCNF p f := by
        apply List.filter_eq_self.mpr
        intro c hc
        have noHit : List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2) = false := by
          apply List.any_eq_false.mpr
          intro l hl
          have member : l.1 ∈ CNFVars (RestrictedCNF p f) :=
            List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨c, hc, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩⟩
          have info := support l.1 member
          simp [info.2]
        simp [noHit]
      change List.map (ReducedClause p) (List.filter (fun c => !(List.any c (fun l => p l.1 == some l.2))) (RestrictedCNF p f)) = RestrictedCNF p f
      rw [keepAll]
      have mapped : List.map (ReducedClause p) (RestrictedCNF p f) = List.map (fun c => c) (RestrictedCNF p f) :=
        List.map_congr_left unchanged
      simpa [id] using mapped
  
)
